Ethan M: Heads-up: Prospect (NordBank) accepted POC invite but require BYO HSM (CloudHSM) with 30d rotation and split escrow. Need ops ETA, pricing delta, and prefilled security answers for their questionnaire.
Leila K: High level: vendor confirm -> customer provides wrapped test key + attestation -> we deploy proxy in their VPC or they pull image -> smoke tests -> key ceremony/escrow.
Ethan M: Ballpark delta for BYO proxy + reserved throughput? Sales needs a figure.
Leila K: Typical: one-time setup $8k-$11k (proxy + attestation validation), monthly reserved capacity $1k-$1.6k. PS days for onsite ceremony $2k/day. If they insist on <24h rotation or geo-replicated HSMs add a premium.
Diego P: Questionnaire bullets: attestation formats we accept, audit fields (key_id, key_version, op, ts, principal, request_id), retention options, split-escrow support, and non-storage of plaintext keys.
Ethan M: Can automatic rotation keep older ciphertexts usable?
Leila K: Yes. We rotate envelope keys and keep key-version metadata so old ciphertext decrypts against prior versions. We don't hold unencrypted key material.
Diego P: Ops ETA: with materials (allowlist, IAM role, wrapped key) we can spin proxy in 2 business days, smoke tests 1 day, remote ceremony 1-3 days depending on custodians. Total POC ~4-6 business days after materials arrive.
ops-bot: Created workspace: workspace/nordbank-byo-2934567000 (owner: @Leila K).
Ethan M: Action items: Leila - pricing + SOW appendix; Diego - seed questionnaire answers; I'll request wrapped key and vendor confirmation from customer.
Leila K: Will add sample wrapped-key format and attestation checklist.
Diego P: Flagging CloudHSM cluster accessibility and FIPS module version capture for compliance.
Ethan M: Thanks, closing thread until customer confirms vendor/wrapped key.
